title: 2-Year Treasury Note auction (December new issue) — announced on Christmas Eve, sharing Monday 12-28 with the 5-Year
source: EST: treasury.gov Tentative Schedule of Treasury Auctions PDF (home.treasury.gov/system/files/221/Tentative-Auction-Schedule.pdf), fetched direct by plain curl 2026-09-09 (HTTP 200, 17,195 bytes) and its text layer decompressed stream-by-stream by the treasury-7y-note-2026-12-29 initial research. Row reads verbatim `2-Year NOTE Thursday, December 24, 2026 Monday, December 28, 2026 Thursday, December 31, 2026` with NO trailing `R`, so a new issue — and the flag column IS populated in the same December block (`2-Year FRN R`, `20-Year BOND R`, `5-Year TIPS R T`), so the blank is a signal rather than a missing field. Filed estimate on the two limits this lane records: a tentative schedule is tentative by construction, and this lane may not self-confirm an event it discovered in-sweep — the confirming primary is the 2026-12-24 announcement. Discovered in the never-assessed initial research of treasury-7y-note-2026-12-29, 2026-09-09
notes: PROPOSED 2026-09-09 by the treasury-7y-note-2026-12-29 never-assessed initial research, one day inside its five-day corridor and previously untracked. WHY IT EARNS A ROW: the December month-end coupon block is compressed onto TWO sessions instead of the usual three — the 2-Year AND the 5-Year both auction Monday 2026-12-28, the 7-Year takes Tuesday 12-29, and all three settle Thursday 12-31. A 2Y and 5Y sharing one auction date is common overall (53 of the 152 months since 2014) but rare in December: 2020-12-28 is the ONLY other December in the record where it happened, and 2026's late-December weekday calendar is identical to 2020's (Dec 24 Thu, Dec 25 Fri holiday, Dec 28 Mon, Dec 29 Tue, Dec 31 Thu). Like the 7-Year that follows it, this auction gets a compressed when-issued window — announced Thursday 12-24, auctioned Monday 12-28, one business day of when-issued trading against the 3-5 that is normal. The proposing research measured when-issued compression as a NULL at the 7-Year tenor (29 auctions with a window of 3 business days or fewer residual -0.019bp off the dealer-takedown model vs +0.004bp for the other 123, t = -0.10; bid-to-cover 2.460 vs 2.501, t = -1.42), which is a hypothesis the front end has not been tested on.
